default.title: Restaurant operations, controlled accounting, and complete CRM lifecycle
default.summary: ClawPilot now provides an organization-scoped POS workspace for Toast orders, checks, products, payments, daily reporting, and accounting preparation. QuickBooks reference catalogs and versioned mappings support reviewable Sales Receipt and Payments Journal previews without enabling financial posting, while CRM adds durable Leads and Campaigns workflows and the demo account includes rolling synthetic operations data.
features: A first-class POS workspace with Overview, Orders, Reports, and Accounting views on desktop and mobile
Toast Standard order, modified-order, and menu-catalog ingestion with optional Analytics reconciliation
Business-day receipts, check detail, product/category performance, payment, card-brand, cash, comparison, and run-rate reports
Itemized Sales Receipt and balanced Payments Journal previews built from sanitized order evidence
Versioned organization defaults and restaurant overrides for QuickBooks company, account, item, tax, class, department, customer, and memo mappings
Read-only QuickBooks reference catalogs used to validate POS accounting destinations
CRM Leads and Campaigns with Global IDs, search, edit, archive, lead conversion, recipient membership, activity history, and SuiteCRM synchronization
Rolling synthetic POS and accounting data in the protected demo account without live provider credentials or customer identity
Environment database fingerprints for Railway and Vercel isolation verification
A release regression gate covering disposable Postgres CRM and POS workflows plus 38 responsive browser scenarios
fixes: Refreshes every affected business day when Toast reports a modified historical order
Prevents stale Toast workers from writing or completing a lease claimed by another worker
Keeps failed and dead Toast work terminal until an operator explicitly reviews and retries it
Excludes voided and deleted orders or checks and accounts for partial refunds and refunded tips in POS totals
Preserves approved, posting, and posted accounting evidence when projections or previews refresh
Invalidates stale POS mappings and cancels only unposted QuickBooks writes when a company connection is replaced or disconnected
Blocks accounting preparers from changing organization-wide defaults while allowing authorized location overrides
Fails deployed persistence health when Postgres or the environment database identity is missing
Keeps CRM editors, campaign recipients, converted records, and related activity contained in phone portrait and landscape layouts
